Question B-002-004-005.

Why the correct answer is right: A dummy load is used so a transceiver can be tested or adjusted without putting a test signal onto the air.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "To give comparative signal reports": Comparative signal reports require radiated signals; a dummy load is meant to prevent that radiation.
- sourceIndex 2: "It is faster to tune": Speed is not the main reason; the important point is non-radiating adjustment.
- sourceIndex 3: "To reduce output power": A dummy load may dissipate full transmitter power, so its purpose is not simply to reduce output power.
